messages:
IncidentBot: PAGER: Latency-SLO thrash detected in us-west-2 — p95 exceeded threshold repeatedly. Automated fallback loop triggered (model variant + cross-region) multiple times.
Maya: grabbed alert. noticed p95 went from ~110ms -> 1.1s on /v1/generate around 2309123200
Sam: I'm on this. pulling routing and serving metrics now. can someone paste current routing policy?
Jake: routing trace shows: p95 breach -> fallback to redwood-medium-q4 -> capacity shortage -> region fallback to us-east -> retries -> back to us-west. no hysteresis between decisions.
Erin: yep, double fallback axis (variant + region) + zero backoff = oscillation. We need to stop cross-region auto-fallback asap.
CS-Rep: customers are seeing timeouts. opened tickets for 4 customers (prod). escalating.
Sam: quick-stop plan: 1) disable automatic cross-region fallback for production routes, 2) temporarily pin model variant on hot routes, 3) increase routing hysteresis timers. Which has smallest blast radius?
Jake: disabling region fallback is low risk. I'll run the CLI change:
```
redwoodctl routing set --route /v1/generate --disable-region-fallback=true
```
Maya: go for it. notify customers immediately after.
Jake: applied at 2309123789. API acknowledged. monitoring.
IncidentBot: config change recorded (user: Jake) at 2309123789. Sam assigned incident lead.
Sam: after change p95 dropped to ~240ms within a minute. reduced reroute events observed.
Erin: still see noisy model-variant fallbacks. current fallback allows 'size-only' downgrades without eval gating. propose: require quality delta < X or block variant fallback during high churn.
Maya: CS update posted to customers: disabled cross-region fallback and pinning in progress. ETA for full fix TBD.
Jake: pinning command executed:
```
redwoodctl model pin --route /v1/generate --model redwood-large-v2 --ttl 2h
```
Pinned at 2309124120.
Sam: good. tail latency stabilized around 170-260ms for 20m. no new pagers.
IncidentBot: incident labeled SEV-2 "routing-slo-thrash". paging suspended at 2309124200. continue watch.
Maya: handing off monitoring to rotation for 4h. @OncallRotation please monitor p95 and escalate at >400ms.
OncallRotation: acknowledged. will monitor and follow runbook.
Erin: creating ticket INF-4729: Routing policy hysteresis + fallback gating. Owner Jake. Plan: add exponential backoff, variant quality check, and fallback churn metric. ETA: config patch 1 week, canary rollout 4 weeks.
Sam: I'll own the postmortem. include timeline, customer impact, config diffs, and recommendations (playbook entry for "disable-region-fallback").
CS-Rep: customers updated at 2309124600 that issue is mitigated and we're working on permanent fix. they accepted temporary measures.
Jake: attaching logs and config diffs to INF-4729.
Maya: closing slack incident thread. move long-term discussion to #eng-runtime and link INF-4729. :white_check_mark:
Sam: thanks team. @IncidentBot please archive after 24h.
IncidentBot: Archived on request. Nice work. :thumbsup:
